zh_summary: @SawyerMerritt 分享 Tesla FSD（監督版）安全數據：使用 FSD 每6,006,200英里發生一次重大碰撞，手動駕駛連主動安全功能為2,031,221英里，無主動安全功能為845,915英里，美國平均為660,164英里。
text:
Tesla has released new FSD (Supervised) safety data.

Miles per major collision:
• Teslas Driven With FSD (Supervised): 6,006,200
• Teslas Driven Manually (Active Safety Features): 2,031,221
• Teslas Driven Manually (No Active Safety Features): 845,915
• U.S. Average: 660,164

Total major collisions:
• Teslas with FSD (Supervised): 1,579
• Teslas driven manually with Active Safety: 17,775
• Teslas driven manually without Active Safety: 239
• U.S. average: 4,989,713

Total miles logged:
• Teslas with FSD (Supervised): 9,483,790,215
• Teslas driven manually with Active Safety: 36,104,958,020
• Teslas driven manually without Active Safety: 202,173,600
• U.S. drivers overall: 3,294,031,000,000

Tesla vehicles with FSD (Supervised) engaged experienced ~9x fewer major collisions than those driving without it on.

This is North America data across all road classes (highway and non-highway). The data reflects a rolling twelve-month aggregation of miles and collisions.

name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: $RKLB 剛剛將 Neutron 的第二級和推力模組運送至發射綜合體 3，模組直接送至發射臺進行測試，然後火箭才完全組裝。Neutron 不使用傳統的強背架，因此現在測試其與發射臺的唯一連接，有助避免昂貴的發射延誤，並允許未來發射之間更快、更便宜的周轉。
text:
$RKLB just shipped Neutron’s Stage 2 and Thrust Module to Launch Complex 3 with the module heading straight onto the pad for testing before rocket is fully stacked.

What’s interesting is Neutron doesn’t use a traditional strongback so testing its only connection to pad now could help avoid costly launch delays while allowing for faster and cheaper turnarounds between future launches.
